title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.18861v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. translated_abstract: 我们如何构建一个能够超越人类语言进行思考，但仍通过语言在外部环境中行动的智能体？现代LLM智能体仍然通过文本进行推理和交互，而潜在推理提供了一种高效的内部媒介，但缺乏原生的工具访问能力和推理透明度。我们通过混合推理智能体弥合了这两个方向，它在统一的生成过程中动态地在潜在推理和基于文本的交互之间切换。在架构上，轻量级的HybridLink实现了文本模式和潜在模式之间的无缝切换，同时智能体的连续工作记忆在多轮对话中保留了无损的混合上下文。这些设计在保留工具集成的智能体能力的同时，使潜在思维可以直接被检查。基于这一架构，我们进一步开发了专门用于混合推理的后训练算法：HybridSFT稳定了工具集成的混合
tldr: 提出混合推理智能体（HybridAgents），通过轻量级HybridLink和连续工作记忆，使智能体在潜在推理与文本交互之间动态切换，同时兼顾高效内部推理、工具使用能力和推理透明度。
en_tdlr: HybridAgents dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction via a lightweight HybridLink and continuous working memory, combining efficient internal reasoning with tool-integrated agentic capabilities and reasoning transparency.
